clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Deathguard Samsa envies those sent against the human settlements of the Hillsbrad Foothills. He asks for thirty human skulls taken in battle for his collection.

High Executor Darthalia directs the Forsaken campaign against Hillsbrad's human settlements. Deathguard Samsa remains on sentry duty in Tarren Mill, while others are sent to raid, burn, and pillage. He envies their chance to slaughter the living, a privilege denied to a guard fixed in place.

Samsa hates the humans of Hillsbrad and collects the skulls of those slain in the campaign. He asks for thirty, not for an arcane rite or military plan, but as trophies from a war he longs to fight himself.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad. So jealous I am...
While you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.

Perhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself? You see I am collecting human skulls. And you will be fighting humans for quite some time. Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So the lucky friend returns? How many humans have you slaughtered today? Hundreds I do hope!
Have you any skulls for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Precious skulls! So beautiful! I owe you as promised, friend!
